original_test_intent: Validate every populated power-supply sensor and redundancy indication in SDR and Sensor views through verified IB and OOB paths against the platform specification.
original_method: Inventory PSU slots, serials and AC feeds; map expected presence/electrical/thermal/fan/status records; collect complete protected SDR and Sensor outputs through same-target IB/OOB paths; normalize units, thresholds, freshness and redundancy state; compare per slot without changing load, power or fan policy.
manual_activity: The owner/vendor supplies PSU population, feeds, canonical sensor set, SPEC and redundancy rules; the operator reviews slot, feed or unavailable-value exceptions and sets the verdict.
safety_requirements: Never alter PSU policy, AC feeds, load, power or fan state
Do not accept a generic PSU match as complete coverage
Never retry automatically to mask transient or divergent power data
agent_execution_scope: Resolve per-slot sensor and redundancy mapping
Collect complete SDR and Sensor views on both paths
Normalize and compare electrical/thermal/status evidence to SPEC
Archive evidence and report without verdict
engineer_actions: Approve PSU population and feed mapping
Supply sensor SPEC and redundancy rules
Review missing, duplicate, stale or divergent records

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: It queries an unverified title string through insecure SSH, truncates SDR output and omits OOB/Sensor-list and per-slot redundancy evidence.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use approved protected IB/OOB transport to collect complete `sdr elist` and `sensor list`, then join every PSU record to the captured slot/serial/feed map before evaluating SPEC and redundancy.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The four read-only views and 10/10-minute envelope are preserved; missing transport policy, identity and completeness gates are added without changing load.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Produce a per-PSU matrix containing slot, serial, feed state, presence, input/output electrical readings, temperatures, fan/status records, redundancy indication, four-path values and SPEC result.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds physical/feed identity, complete sensor families, redundancy semantics and protected OOB transport before comparison.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A grep can miss non-PSU aliases or accept duplicate/partial records and cannot prove that redundancy corresponds to actual populated feeds.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Readings can vary with load and standby mode; the captured load/feed state must accompany evidence, but this case does not authorize changing either.

project_override_considerations: The Project must define fitted PSU count, 2700 W model applicability, feed topology, expected standby behavior and the full record set. Hot removal, AC drop or load transitions belong to separately approved cases.
expected_evidence: Target identity, firmware, PSU slot/serial/feed inventory and cipher policy
Canonical sensor map and SPEC version
Complete redacted SDR and Sensor outputs from IB/OOB

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, PSU filters and criteria consistently target power-supply sensors. Missing population, field map, transport and redundancy semantics are prerequisites rather than competing objectives.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The PSU inventory, sensor map, SPEC and cipher policy are obtainable project inputs. Execution reports BLOCKED if stable slot/feed identity or complete protected evidence cannot be established.

review_improvement: Turns a generic PSU text search into a complete per-slot electrical, thermal and redundancy audit tied to the real feed topology without disturbing power.
independent_technical_reasoning: PSU redundancy is a system-level relation, while voltage, current, power, temperature and fan records are per module or rail. A healthy value on one supply cannot cover a missing peer, and an unavailable standby reading may be valid only under the approved feed policy. The test therefore needs both the physical feed map and a field-by-field matrix rather than a single status line.
